title: Games made with Unity: October 2026 in review
summary: Stay updated with the latest creations from the Unity community. Explore our list of standout games made with Unity in October 2026.
body_markdown:
***October 2026 brought strong representation for Unity developers across major industry events and game launches. The Australian Game Developer Awards (AGDAs) saw* Key Fairy *,* Schrödinger’s Cat Burglar *, and* Static Shift Racing *winning top prizes. Unity sponsored the MIX Fall Showcase 2026. A few of the month’s bigger launches included* SULFUR *and* Mycopunk *leaving early access, and* Probably Stolen *’s successful Next Fest demo and subsequent 1.0 release. Get the full recap in our summary of Made with Unity games for October 2026 below.***


### **Award-winning Unity games: October 2026**


Unity developers were well-represented at this year’s AGDA awards, with six of the winners made with Unity.


#### **Made with Unity winners at the 2026 AGDA Awards**


- [Key Fairy](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2878580/Key_Fairy/) by Owl Machine **(Excellence in Debut, presented by Screen Queensland)**
- [Schrödinger’s Cat Burglar](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111550/Schrodingers_Cat_Burglar/) by Abandoned Sheep **(Excellence in Narrative)**
- [Static Shift Racing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/static-shift-racing/id1618130846) by Timbo Jimbo **(Excellence in Ongoing, presented by Sledgehammer Games)**


Congratulations also to the other Unity finalists:[Momento](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2474770/Momento/) by Fat Alien Cat & Nomo Studio,[On Point](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2296750/On_Point/) by Actuator Games,[The Last Werewolf](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2212520/The_Last_Werewolf/) by Unnatural Freaks,[Crabmeat](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3671850/Crabmeat/) by Nicholas McDonnell,[Crossy Road Castle](https://www.crossyroadcastle.com/) by Hipster Whale,[Aether & Iron](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1836560/Aether_Iron/) by Chaos Theory Games, and[Go-Go Town!](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2195120/GoGo_Town/) by Prideful Sloth.


### **Made with Unity at the MIX showcase**


We sponsored this month’s MIX showcase, and a lot of Unity games were on the bill. Watch the full showcase to see new and upcoming games including:


- [MR. RECORDS](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3053470/MR_RECORDS/) by Glee-Cheese Studio
- [Kitaria Fables 2](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3471750/Kitaria_Fables_2/) by Secret Level Studios
- [Voidwood](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694420/Voidwood/) by Santa Barbara Games
- [Coral Island](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158160/Coral_Island/) by Stairway Games
